subject: Beauty of Joseon Revive eye serum : Ginseng + Retinal

description:
When we lack the protein that imparts elasticity to the dermal layer of the skin, collagen and hyaluronic acid decrease, which causes wrinkles. We created an eye serum that helps to improve wrinkles on the sensitive skin around the eyes by combining ginseng extract and retinal.

From the very beginning, we knew we wanted ginseng as the base ingredient for the eye serum because there are multiple studies showing that ginseng is effective in improving wrinkles due to containing abundant amounts of saponins. Ginseng is a well-known herbal ingredient with excellent efficacy.

Vitamin A was, without a doubt, the number one ingredient we wanted to combine with ginseng. There are two types of vitamin A used as cosmetic ingredients, retinol and retinal. Our most important task was to achieve ingredient stability and reduce skin irritation at the same time.
2% (active ingredient 0.02%) of retinal stabilized in the form of liposomes was blended into the formula so that customers can experience retinal for themselves.

subject: The Retinol 0.1 Cream
howtouse:
START SMALL AND SLOW!

• After using essence or serum, pat a small amount using your ring finger. Apply evenly over the face, neck, and onto parts with wrinkle concerns.
• Limit initial use to three times per week; gradually increase frequency to every other night, use as tolerated.

* Have an ‘adaption period’ when using retinol 

WEEK 1~2 

• Frequency : use every other day at night
• How to Use : After cleansing, at the moisturizer step, apply a small amount to areas of concern.
• e.g. under eyes, mouth, forehead and neck 
(Recommended amount : 0.1ml per section / 1 grain of rice) 

WEEK 3~ 

• Frequency : may apply everyday at night
• How to use : After cleansing, at the moisturizer step, may spread over the entire face.

* The &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;building tolerance&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; phase can be shortened or extended depending on individual differences. 
* Maintain this phase until no discomfort is experienced. 
* Gradually increase frequency and areas of application.
description:
The Retinol 0.1 Cream is an irritation-reduced solution created with the optimal ratio of key ingredients for first-time retinol users just starting to notice the appearance of fine lines caused by dry skin. The perfect choice to prevent and correct early signs of ageing before they set in. This cream helps:

• Improve the appearance of fine lines, creases, and wrinkles • Increase skin elasticity • Smooth skin texture • Prevent acne & fades scarring • Moisturise

subject: Karseell Argan Oil Hair Treatment Shampoo

 * Work the lather down to the ends of your hair. This helps distribute the shampoo's conditioning benefits throughout your hair.

subject: VT - Reedle Shot All In One 3 Step Mask
howtouse:
1. Apply an appropriate amount of Reedle Shot 300 to the face after washing. Massage the formula across the face.

The VT Reedle Shot All-In-One 3 Step Mask is a popular Korean skincare product that promises to hydrate and revitalize your skin. It consists of three steps:
Step 1: Reedle Shot 300
This essence is formulated with hyaluronic acid and amino acids to hydrate and plump the skin. It also contains VT's patented CICA REEDLE™ technology, which uses micro-needles to help ingredients penetrate deeper into the skin.
Step 2: Reedle Shot Mask
This sheet mask is infused with peptides, panthenol, and hyaluronic acid to further hydrate and soothe the skin. It also helps to reduce the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles.
Step 3: Reedle Shot Cream
This cream locks in moisture and helps to repair the skin barrier. It also contains CICA REEDLE™ technology to help ingredients penetrate deeper into the skin.
Overall, the VT Reedle Shot All-In-One 3 Step Mask is a great option for those looking to hydrate and revitalize their skin. It is gentle enough for daily use and can be used on all skin types.
Here are some additional things to keep in mind:
 * The mask may cause a slight tingling sensation due to the CICA REEDLE™ technology. This is normal and should go away after a few minutes.
 * It is important to follow the instructions on the packaging carefully.
 * Be sure to use sunscreen during the day, as the mask may make your skin more sensitive to the sun.
